strategies.reason: Approved stage 2: fifteen-minute range, frozen body direction and twenty-session median opening RVOL > 1. Completed post-range five-minute close strictly beyond outward-valid trigger commits next-opening market entry (earliest 09:50 New York). Stop is completed breakout candle low/high rounded outward without added buffer. Known-close sizing, actual gap fills and 3R, lagged opening liquidity, existing protection/costs/caps/deadline and two filled parents with fresh post-resolution inside rearm. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 8 November 2026: Zarattini, Barbon and Aziz (SSRN 4729284) trade rules as a rules check on the run's own stock list: 5-minute range and direction, opening volume at least its 14-session mean, stop order at the range, stop 10% of the 14-day ATR from the trigger, no target, one entry per stock per day. The paper's daily top-20 stock selection is not applied. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 10 November 2026: 2.0.0 trade rules plus two published rules it lacked: stop measured from the actual entry fill (10% of the 14-day ATR) and exit at the session's official close with the order live until 16:00. Run with orb-published-recipe-profile.yaml for the paper's $0.0035/share commission and 4x gross exposure cap. The paper's daily top-20 stock selection is not applied. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 13 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-13/etf-trend-core-design.md, option B): Faber (2007) timing rule on the 15 index and sector funds. At each month's last close hold a fund whose close is above its 210-session average, otherwise cash; fill at the next open; fixed equal slots without monthly rebalancing; 5 bps per side; as-traded bars without dividends. Research only.

Comparison control for etf.trend-10m@1.0.0, required by its pass rules: buys each fund at its first eligible month-end and never sells, with the same slots, timing, costs and bars. A measurement benchmark, never a strategy to trade.
